title: Mechanical Properties of Solids and Fluids
summary: Solids deformation ka virodh karte hain: elastic limit ke andar stress ∝ strain (Hooke's law). Young's, bulk aur shear moduli stretching, squeezing aur twisting ki stiffness naapte hain.
Rukay hue fluid mein pressure depth ke saath badhta hai (P = P₀ + ρgh) aur har direction mein barabar transmit hota hai (Pascal's law) — hydraulic lift aur brakes isi par.

Behte fluid continuity (Av = constant) aur Bernoulli's principle (P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant) follow karte hain. Viscosity flow ka virodh karti hai; girta sphere terminal velocity tak pahunchta hai (Stokes' law).
Surface tension liquid surface ko khinchi hui jhilli jaisa banata hai: drops aur bubbles ke andar excess pressure aur capillary rise isi se.

formulas.name: Stress and strain
formulas.formula: stress = F/A (N/m²);  longitudinal strain = ΔL/L;  volume strain = ΔV/V;  shear strain = θ
formulas.mistake: Strain ki koi unit nahi; stress ki unit pressure wali — confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Hooke's law and Young's modulus
formulas.mistake: ΔL ∝ L/A — patli ya lambi wire same load par zyada khinchti hai, ulta mat socho.

formulas.name: Bulk modulus and compressibility
formulas.when: Body ko har taraf se dabaana.
formulas.mistake: Minus sign B ko positive banata hai kyunki volume ghatta hai — sign mat bhoolo.

formulas.name: Shear modulus (modulus of rigidity)
formulas.when: Layers ko twist ya slide karna.

formulas.name: Poisson's ratio
formulas.formula: σ = (lateral strain)/(longitudinal strain) = −(Δd/d)/(ΔL/L);  theoretical range −1 to 0.5
formulas.when: Wire kheenchne par motai mein badlav.

formulas.name: Elastic potential energy
formulas.formula: U = ½ × stress × strain × volume = ½ F ΔL;  energy density u = stress²/2Y

formulas.name: Pressure in a fluid at rest
formulas.mistake: Gauge pressure = ρgh (P₀ ke bina) — check karo question kaunsa maang raha hai.

formulas.name: Pascal's law: hydraulic lift
formulas.mistake: Force multiply hota hai, work nahi — chhota piston zyada door chalta hai.

formulas.name: Equation of continuity
formulas.when: Badalte area wale pipe mein incompressible fluid ki speed.

formulas.name: Bernoulli's principle
formulas.formula: P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant along a streamline
formulas.when: Venturi meter, aerofoil lift, udti chhatein, atomisers.
formulas.mistake: Sirf steady, non-viscous, incompressible, streamline flow ke liye valid.

formulas.name: Torricelli's law (speed of efflux)
formulas.formula: v = √(2gh)  (h = depth of the hole below the free surface)

formulas.name: Viscous force and Stokes' law
formulas.formula: F = η A (dv/dx);  on a sphere F = 6πηrv
formulas.when: Spheres aur oil drops par drag.

formulas.name: Terminal velocity
formulas.when: Baarish ki boondein, glycerine mein ball bearings.
formulas.mistake: v_t ∝ r² — double radius wali boond chaar guna tez girti hai, double nahi.

formulas.name: Reynolds number and critical velocity
formulas.formula: Rₑ = ρ v D/η;  streamline below ~1000, turbulent above ~2000
formulas.when: Flow smooth hoga ya turbulent, ye batana.

formulas.name: Surface tension and surface energy
formulas.formula: S = F/L = (surface energy)/(area);  work to increase area W = S ΔA
formulas.mistake: Soap bubble ki DO surfaces hoti hain — area double lo, bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Excess pressure
formulas.formula: liquid drop / air bubble in a liquid: ΔP = 2S/r;  soap bubble in air: ΔP = 4S/r
formulas.mistake: 4S/r sirf soap bubble (do surfaces) ke liye; drop ke liye 2S/r — mix mat karo.

formulas.name: General curved surface (pressure jump)
formulas.formula: ΔP = S(1/R₁ + 1/R₂);  sphere R₁ = R₂ = r → 2S/r;  cylindrical surface (R₂ = ∞) → S/R;  gently curved surface y(x): 1/R ≈ d²y/dx²
formulas.when: Liquid surface sirf ek direction mein curved ho (lamba trough, wall ke paas) — ρgy se balance karo.
formulas.mistake: Pressure concave side par zyada hota hai. 2S/r aur 4S/r isi ke special cases hain — cylinder par 2S/r mat lagao.

formulas.name: Capillary rise
formulas.when: Patli tube mein liquid chadhna ya girna.
formulas.mistake: θ > 90° (glass mein mercury) ho to h negative — liquid girta hai, chadhta nahi.

examples.problem: 1 mm radius ki paani ki boond hawa mein girti hai (η = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ Pa s; hawa ki density ignore). Terminal velocity?

topics.title: Stress–strain curve
topics.explain: Proportional limit tak graph seedhi line (Hooke's law). Elastic limit ke baad body apni shape wapas nahi leti; yield point par plastic flow hota hai, breaking point par toot jaati hai. Ductile materials (copper) ka plastic region lamba; brittle (glass) elastic limit ke turant baad toot-te hain.

topics.title: Applications of elasticity
topics.explain: Steel rubber se zyada elastic hai (Y zyada). Beams I-section ke banate hain taaki kam material mein bending ka virodh ho. Crane ki rassi kai patle strands ki hoti hai, aur pahaad ki maximum height chattanon ki elastic limit se tay hoti hai.

topics.title: Pressure facts
topics.explain: Depth par pressure sirf depth par depend karta hai, bartan ki shape par nahi (hydrostatic paradox). Atmospheric pressure ≈ 1.013 × 10⁵ Pa = 76 cm mercury. Barometer ise naapta hai; open-tube manometer gauge pressure. Rukke hue fluid ke andar har point par pressure hota hai (sirf wall par nahi), aur us point par har direction mein barabar lagta hai.

topics.title: Buoyancy and floating
topics.explain: Upthrust = displaced fluid ka weight (Archimedes). Body tab tairti hai jab uski density fluid se kam ho; dooba hua hissa = ρ_body/ρ_fluid.

topics.title: Streamline and turbulent flow
topics.explain: Streamline flow mein kisi point par velocity time ke saath nahi badalti aur streamlines kabhi nahi kaat-ti. Critical velocity se upar flow turbulent ho jaata hai aur Bernoulli lagu nahi hota.

topics.title: Applications of Bernoulli
topics.explain: Aerofoil: wing ke upar tez hawa → kam pressure → lift. Toofan mein chhatein ud jaati hain. Saath chalti do naavein ek-doosre ki taraf khinchti hain. Atomiser aur Bunsen burner tez speed wali jagah fluid kheenchte hain.

topics.title: Viscosity
topics.explain: Liquids ki viscosity temperature badhne par ghatti hai; gases ki badhti hai. Unit: Pa s (poiseuille); 1 poise = 0.1 Pa s.

topics.title: Surface tension effects
topics.explain: Origin: surface wale molecule ke padosi sirf ek taraf hote hain, isliye uski potential energy andar wale molecule se zyada hoti hai; liquid ye extra energy kam karne ke liye apna surface area kam karta hai — yahi surface tension hai. Boondein gol hoti hain (minimum area). Surface tension temperature aur detergent se ghatta hai. Angle of contact < 90° → liquid surface ko geela karta hai aur capillary mein chadhta hai (paani–glass); > 90° → geela nahi karta aur girta hai (mercury–glass).

topics.title: Surface tension se curved surface
topics.explain: Jo liquid surface ek hi direction mein mudti hai (doosri direction mein bahut chaudi), uske aar-paar pressure jump = S × curvature, aur halke slope ke liye curvature ≈ d²y/dx². Flat level se y oonchai par surface ke theek neeche liquid ka pressure P₀ − ρgy hota hai, isliye S·d²y/dx² = ρgy, yaani d²y/dx² = (ρg/S)·y. Pehle ye balance likho, phir wall par contact angle ko wahan ka slope dy/dx maano.

ratta: A₁v₁ = A₂v₂;  P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant;  v = √(2gh).
Liquids: viscosity ↓ with T;  gases: viscosity ↑ with T.
ΔP = S(1/R₁ + 1/R₂): sphere 2S/r, cylinder S/R, gentle surface S·d²y/dx².
Rukke fluid mein har point par pressure hota hai;  surface tension = surface molecules ki extra PE.
